description: Unit tests for the ReportingUploader component in Chromium, testing upload success, failure scenarios, CORS preflight handling, redirect following, cookie handling, caching, and network isolation key behavior.

classes.name: ReportingUploaderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing ReportingUploader functionality with various scenarios.

classes.name: TestUploadCallback
classes.description: Helper class to handle asynchronous upload completion and outcome retrieval during tests.

methods.name: CheckUpload
methods.description: Verifies that the upload request has correct method, headers, and content.

methods.name: AllowPreflight
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS preflight requests, returning appropriate CORS headers.

methods.name: ReturnResponse
methods.description: Returns a simple HTTP response with specified status code.

methods.name: ReturnInvalidResponse
methods.description: Returns an invalid HTTP response to simulate network failure.

methods.name: TestUploadCallback::callback
methods.description: Returns a callback bound to the completion handler.

methods.name: TestUploadCallback::WaitForCall
methods.description: Blocks until the upload callback is invoked.

methods.name: TestUploadCallback::outcome
methods.description: Returns the outcome of the upload after completion.

methods.name: VerifyPreflight
methods.description: Checks if a preflight OPTIONS request was received.

methods.name: ReturnPreflightError
methods.description: Simulates a failed CORS preflight with HTTP 403.

methods.name: ReturnPreflightWithoutOrigin
methods.description: Preflight response missing the Origin header.

methods.name: ReturnPreflightWithWildcardMethods
methods.description: Preflight response with wildcard methods allowed.

methods.name: ReturnPreflightWithWildcardHeaders
methods.description: Preflight response with wildcard headers allowed.

methods.name: CheckRedirect
methods.description: Checks if a redirect was followed.

methods.name: CheckNoCookie
methods.description: Verifies that no Cookie header is sent.

methods.name: ReturnCacheableResponse
methods.description: Returns a cacheable HTTP response, increments request count.
